summary: An invoicing service: a service layer that enforces invoice rules over a swappable store. Here the store is in memory and the only caller is a small command-line entry point.

areas.name: Entry point
areas.purpose: Wire the store into the service and run.

claims.text: InvoiceService owns every invoice state change; the store only persists rows.
pay() refuses any invoice whose status is not open, then sets it to paid and writes it back through store.update.
total_due() sums cents over open invoices only.
The store is in memory so tests stay fast and offline; a real store would keep the same four methods.
MemoryStore.get returns a copy, so mutating the result does nothing until update() is called.
Email validation lives in app/members/invite.py, before anything is stored.
build_service() is the one place the store is chosen; tests use it too.
make test runs the unittest suite under tests/.

open_questions: Nothing in the record says why invite() lowercases the email.
